title: Crypto's campaign efforts see rare loss, but crypto roster in Congress likely to grow
summary: The leading industry PAC, Fairshake, put $2 million into a Detroit Democratic primary but came up short, even as several PAC-backed candidates won elsewhere.

title: Coldcard exploit could boost demand for regulated bitcoin exposure, analysts say
summary: Cantor sees positive read-through for crypto custody providers, while FRNT says the breach could drive some investors toward bitcoin ETFs.

title: Crypto Long & Short: Putting the bitcoin sizing question to the test
summary: In a follow-up to his essay on sizing crypto risk, Lionsoul Global's Gregory Mall backtests bitcoin in a 60/40 across bull, bear and sideways regimes, showing how a straight bitcoin position, a large-cap basket and a trend-managed sleeve part ways and why the way you hold bitcoin can matter as much as how much you hold.

title: Strategy’s STRC rebounds 30% as company builds cash reserve, bitcoin price stabilizes
summary: Bitcoin sales, what is now a $4 billion cash reserve, and a $975 million repurchase program, have supported STRC’s recovery.

title: Nomura’s Laser Digital backs ZIGChain for onchain private credit push in UAE
summary: Laser’s investment in ZIGChain is understood to be in the single-digit millions.
